records.title: Florida RN initial licensure: examination, prior-NCLEX and MOBILE routes
records.overview: Selected official Board steps for initial Florida Registered Nurse licensure. The alternatives shown are initial licensure by examination, application after a previously passed NCLEX, and MOBILE endorsement. This is not a complete eligibility determination; Board equivalency, individual screening, disciplinary and other exceptions remain subject to Board review. Re-examination and multistate-upgrade procedures are outside this pathway.
records.review_note: Revision 2 separates first-time NCLEX applicants, applicants who already passed NCLEX, and MOBILE endorsement. RN-specific pre-licensure MSN/higher education remains RN-only. MOBILE conditions follow the Board page and Florida Statutes §456.0145. Re-examination and multistate upgrade remain out of scope.

children.label: Examination route: graduate from a Florida-approved or accredited nursing education program
Examination route: graduate from an ACEN- or CCNE-accredited nursing program with an NCSBN NCLEX code
Examination route: graduate from a home-jurisdiction-recognized nursing program with an NCSBN NCLEX code
Examination route: obtain Board equivalency approval for a non-NCSBN or international nursing program
children.condition: The Board determines equivalency and may require additional documentation

children.label: Examination route: graduate from a pre-licensure MSN or higher program with an NCSBN NCLEX code
Examination route: submit applicable education proof to the Board
Examination route: complete electronic fingerprinting and Level 2 background screening
Examination route: submit the initial application and required fees
Examination route: obtain Board approval to test and pass the NCLEX
children.condition: For applicants who have not previously passed the applicable NCLEX

children.label: Already-passed NCLEX route: graduate from a Florida-approved or accredited nursing education program
Already-passed NCLEX route: graduate from an ACEN- or CCNE-accredited nursing program with an NCSBN NCLEX code
Already-passed NCLEX route: graduate from a home-jurisdiction-recognized nursing program with an NCSBN NCLEX code
Already-passed NCLEX route: obtain Board equivalency approval for a non-NCSBN or international nursing program
children.condition: The Board determines equivalency and may require additional documentation

children.label: Already-passed NCLEX route: graduate from a pre-licensure MSN or higher program with an NCSBN NCLEX code
Already-passed NCLEX route: submit applicable education proof to the Board
Already-passed NCLEX route: complete electronic fingerprinting and Level 2 background screening
Already-passed NCLEX route: submit the initial application and required fees
Already-passed NCLEX route: have the prior passing NCLEX result verified by the Board
children.condition: No Pearson VUE registration or repeat NCLEX is required when the passing result can be verified

children.label: MOBILE route: hold an active, unencumbered out-of-state, District of Columbia or territorial license in a profession with a similar scope
MOBILE route: have passed a national licensure examination or hold a national certification recognized by the Board
MOBILE route: document at least two years of active practice during the four years immediately before applying
children.condition: Applicants without two years of practice may need to apply by examination

children.label: MOBILE route: satisfy the National Practitioner Data Bank reporting condition
children.condition: No report unless successfully appealed and removed, or the adverse action would not violate Florida law or rule

children.label: MOBILE route: not be subject to a practice-related disciplinary proceeding in a licensing jurisdiction or by the U.S. Department of Defense
MOBILE route: have no disciplinary action in the five years immediately before applying
MOBILE route: submit the initial endorsement application and required supporting materials
MOBILE route: arrange verification of the out-of-state license and transfer of national examination scores
MOBILE route: complete required electronic fingerprinting
Complete any Board review and supplemental-document requirements applicable to the selected route
Receive the Florida nursing license only after the Board confirms all requirements for the selected route

records.title: Florida LPN initial licensure: examination, prior-NCLEX and MOBILE routes
records.overview: Selected official Board steps for initial Florida Licensed Practical Nurse licensure. The alternatives shown are initial licensure by examination, application after a previously passed NCLEX, and MOBILE endorsement. Practical Nursing Equivalency is an LPN-specific education option for eligible applicants already enrolled in an RN program. This is not a complete eligibility determination; individual screening, disciplinary and other exceptions remain subject to Board review.
